headline_original: Trump: Iran issue is a military conflict, 'small potatoes'
headline_cs: Trump potvrzuje průběžné údery na Írán a zásahy lodí v Hormuzu
summary_cs: Trump uvedl, že USA provádějí intermitentní údery v Íránu, že v noci zasáhly řadu lodí v Hormuzském průlivu a že při zhoršení situace udeří tvrdě. Jde o nový konkrétní eskalační signál nad rámec dřívější íránské rétoriky a udržuje zvýšenou geopolitickou prémii v ropě a bezpečných aktivech.

predictions.mechanism: Confirmed ongoing US strikes and Hormuz military activity support safe-haven demand, but the post-NFP rise in DXY and Treasury yields materially caps conviction.
predictions.invalidation: Clear de-escalation, no further military follow-through, falling oil risk premium, or a sustained rise in DXY and real yields that overwhelms safe-haven demand.

predictions.mechanism: Higher Middle East military risk and elevated oil increase European energy-cost and equity-risk premia.
predictions.invalidation: Rapid geopolitical de-escalation and a material fall in oil without a rise in volatility.

predictions.mechanism: Germany's cyclical industrial mix is sensitive to renewed oil and geopolitical risk premia.
predictions.invalidation: Oil falls sharply and global equities remain risk-on despite the military headlines.

predictions.mechanism: Military escalation and Hormuz risk add to equity risk premia while strong NFP already keeps discount rates elevated.
predictions.invalidation: No follow-through in oil or volatility and US equities absorb the news without additional selling.

predictions.mechanism: The combination of geopolitical risk-off pressure and higher post-NFP yields is a double headwind for duration-sensitive technology shares.
predictions.invalidation: Treasury yields reverse lower enough to dominate geopolitical risk and technology shares regain broad risk-on momentum.

predictions.mechanism: Silver gets some safe-haven support but faces simultaneous pressure from a firmer dollar, higher yields and its industrial-demand sensitivity.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive move in either safe-haven demand or global growth sentiment resolves the conflicting channels.
